chapters.title: The Glories of the Divine Mother

verses.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
verses.translation: To that Goddess who resides in all beings in the form of power and energy — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु बुद्धिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
verses.translation: To that Goddess who resides in all beings in the form of intelligence — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु विद्यारूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
verses.translation: To that Goddess who resides in all beings in the form of knowledge — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her again and again.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वमंगलमांगल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके ।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तुते ॥
verses.translation: O auspicious one, who is the source of all auspiciousness, O Shive, who fulfills all purposes, O Shelter of all, O three-eyed Gauri, O Narayani, salutations to You.

verses.sanskrit:
सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशानां शक्तिभूते सनातनि ।
गुणाश्रये गुणमये नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.translation: O eternal one, who manifests as the power behind creation, preservation, and destruction, who is the refuge of all qualities and full of qualities — O Narayani, salutations to You.

verses.sanskrit:
शरणागतदीनार्तपरित्राणपरायणे ।
सर्वस्यार्तिहरे देवि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.translation: O Devi, who is devoted to protecting the distressed and the suffering who take refuge in You, who removes the sorrows of all — O Narayani, salutations to You.
